rv.q: Mark Strong and Lesley Manville are spellbinding in this wrenchingly tense Greek tragedy
The piece has a cumulative power that builds gradually until the atmosphere is riveting

The Oscar-winning star is the uncanny centre of this season’s second take on the tragedy Oedipus, following Robert Icke’s brilliantly imagined modern-day political retelling last year. It could be classical overkill.
The adaptation excels in the way that Icke identifies the tragedy as being not of one man
Strong and Manville share great chemistry
Mark Strong and Lesley Manville’s Greek tragedy is a political thriller
